task.description: Brief describing the task and limits.

difficulty.description: Deprecated and ignored: the level comes from the difficulty judge.

touches.description: Deprecated and ignored: the level comes from the difficulty judge.

machine.description: Leave empty: a selection field. Set only when your owner named it, with owner_words.

harness.description: Leave empty: a selection field. Set only when your owner named it, with owner_words.

model.description: Model ID or substring as specified.

continue.description: ID of an ended worker to continue.

auto_continue.description: Whether the daemon may continue unfinished work.

title.description: One short line naming the worker, at most 60 characters, with no newlines. Leave it empty to derive a title from the task.

provider.description: Provider ID; omit to resolve from the model.

not_family.description: Leave empty: a selection field. Excludes model families, for example ["openai"]; set only when your owner named it, with owner_words.

fixes.description: Change ID (ch_...) of a shipped change this worker fixes. agent-net records a defect on the worker that made that change, so do not file it yourself.

fixes_severity.description: Severity of that defect, 1 to 4. Default 2.

owner_words.description: A short quote of your owner's own request that names harness, model, provider, effort, family or machine, for example "use a codex worker for this". Needed to set any of those: agent-net checks it appears in what he typed in this session in the last 3 hours. Leave them empty otherwise.

reason.description: Why you set selection fields without owner_words. The start then waits for your owner to confirm it or let the picker choose.

owner_line.description: One line for the caller to tell its user: the model and the judged difficulty.

accepted.description: The start is accepted but the difficulty judge or the launch is still running. A worker notice arrives when the worker starts, waits in the queue or does not start. Do not start it again.

hint.description: One line when the task sounds like a fix: the recent changes in the project that fixes can name.

selection_path.description: Present when you set selection fields: owner_words (his words were found, the start went ahead) or held (the start waits for your owner on his Desk; accepted tells you the start id; a notice follows).
